info.title: stubbur
info.description: Deterministic stub data API for testing ingestion: GB settlement and interval datasets, every common timestamp and value format, envelopes, auth styles and failure scenarios. Routes: `/{auth}/v1/{dataset}`, presets at `/cases/{name}`.

get.description:
Price (£/MWh) and volume (MWh) per settlement period and provider. N2EXMIDP is always 0.

Auth: no auth

Basis: GB settlement periods (Europe/London).

schema.description:
How timestamps in records are written (examples at 2026-07-14T13:30Z, in BST):
- `iso_z`: `"2026-07-14T13:30:00Z"` ISO 8601 in UTC
- `iso_ms_z`: `"2026-07-14T13:30:00.000Z"` ISO 8601 in UTC with milliseconds
- `iso_minutes_z`: `"2026-07-14T13:30Z"` ISO 8601 in UTC without seconds
- `iso_offset`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00+01:00"` London local time with its offset. ⚠ offset changes from +01:00 to +00:00 across the October clock change
- `iso_offset_compact`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00+0100"` London local time, offset without a colon
- `naive_utc`: `"2026-07-14T13:30:00"` UTC wall clock, no zone. ⚠ correct only if the consumer assumes UTC
- `naive_utc_space`: `"2026-07-14 13:30:00"` UTC wall clock, space separator, no zone
- `naive_london`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00"` London wall clock, no zone. ⚠ an hour off in BST if read as UTC; 01:00–02:00 repeats on the October change day
- `naive_london_space`: `"2026-07-14 14:30:00"` London wall clock, space separator, no zone. ⚠ as naive_london
- `date_only`: `"2026-07-14"` UTC date only. ⚠ every record of a day shares one timestamp
- `rfc1123_gmt`: `"Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:30:00 GMT"` RFC 1123 in GMT
- `rfc1123_london`: `"Tue, 14 Jul 2026 14:30:00 BST"` RFC 1123 in London time with BST/GMT. ⚠ parsers that don't know BST read it as UTC, an hour off
- `epoch_s`: `1784035800` Unix seconds, JSON number
- `epoch_ms`: `1784035800000` Unix milliseconds, JSON number
- `epoch_s_string`: `"1784035800"` Unix seconds as a string
- `epoch_ms_string`: `"1784035800000"` Unix milliseconds as a string
- `epoch_s_float`: `1784035800.5` Unix seconds with a fraction
- `epoch_us`: `"1784035800000000"` Unix microseconds (16 digits) as a string
- `epoch_ns`: `"1784035800000000000"` Unix nanoseconds (19 digits) as a string
- `uk_slash`: `"14/07/2026 14:30"` dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm, London time. ⚠ day-first; ambiguous with US order up to the 12th
- `us_slash`: `"07/14/2026 13:30:00"` MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss, UTC
- `compact`: `"20260714T133000Z"` ISO basic format, yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ
- `excel_serial`: `46217.5625` Excel serial day number (UTC)

schema.description:
How the server answers:
- `ok`: 200 with the data
- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts
- `status`: answers `status` (default 500) with a JSON error; 429 and 503 add Retry-After: retryAfter
- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

- `excel_serial`: `46217.5625` Excel serial day number (UTC)

schema.description:
How the server answers:
- `ok`: 200 with the data
- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts
- `status`: answers `status` (default 500) with a JSON error; 429 and 503 add Retry-After: retryAfter
- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

schema.description:
How the server answers:
- `ok`: 200 with the data
- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts
- `status`: answers `status` (default 500) with a JSON error; 429 and 503 add Retry-After: retryAfter
- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

schema.description:
How the server answers:
- `ok`: 200 with the data
- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts
- `status`: answers `status` (default 500) with a JSON error; 429 and 503 add Retry-After: retryAfter
- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

- `ok`: 200 with the data
- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts
- `status`: answers `status` (default 500) with a JSON error; 429 and 503 add Retry-After: retryAfter
- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200

- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts

- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB

- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts
- `status`: answers `status` (default 500) with a JSON error; 429 and 503 add Retry-After: retryAfter
- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain

- `iso_offset`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00+01:00"` London local time with its offset. ⚠ offset changes from +01:00 to +00:00 across the October clock change
- `iso_offset_compact`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00+0100"` London local time, offset without a colon
- `naive_utc`: `"2026-07-14T13:30:00"` UTC wall clock, no zone. ⚠ correct only if the consumer assumes UTC
- `naive_utc_space`: `"2026-07-14 13:30:00"` UTC wall clock, space separator, no zone
- `naive_london`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00"` London wall clock, no zone. ⚠ an hour off in BST if read as UTC; 01:00–02:00 repeats on the October change day
- `naive_london_space`: `"2026-07-14 14:30:00"` London wall clock, space separator, no zone. ⚠ as naive_london

- `epoch_ms`: `1784035800000` Unix milliseconds, JSON number

- `epoch_ms_string`: `"1784035800000"` Unix milliseconds as a string
- `epoch_s_float`: `1784035800.5` Unix seconds with a fraction
- `epoch_us`: `"1784035800000000"` Unix microseconds (16 digits) as a string
- `epoch_ns`: `"1784035800000000000"` Unix nanoseconds (19 digits) as a string
- `uk_slash`: `"14/07/2026 14:30"` dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm, London time. ⚠ day-first; ambiguous with US order up to the 12th
- `us_slash`: `"07/14/2026 13:30:00"` MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss, UTC
- `compact`: `"20260714T133000Z"` ISO basic format, yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ
- `excel_serial`: `46217.5625` Excel serial day number (UTC)

schema.description:
How timestamps in records are written (examples at 2026-07-14T13:30Z, in BST):
- `iso_z`: `"2026-07-14T13:30:00Z"` ISO 8601 in UTC
- `iso_ms_z`: `"2026-07-14T13:30:00.000Z"` ISO 8601 in UTC with milliseconds
- `iso_minutes_z`: `"2026-07-14T13:30Z"` ISO 8601 in UTC without seconds
- `iso_offset`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00+01:00"` London local time with its offset. ⚠ offset changes from +01:00 to +00:00 across the October clock change
- `iso_offset_compact`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00+0100"` London local time, offset without a colon
- `naive_utc`: `"2026-07-14T13:30:00"` UTC wall clock, no zone. ⚠ correct only if the consumer assumes UTC
- `naive_utc_space`: `"2026-07-14 13:30:00"` UTC wall clock, space separator, no zone
- `naive_london`: `"2026-07-14T14:30:00"` London wall clock, no zone. ⚠ an hour off in BST if read as UTC; 01:00–02:00 repeats on the October change day
- `naive_london_space`: `"2026-07-14 14:30:00"` London wall clock, space separator, no zone. ⚠ as naive_london
- `date_only`: `"2026-07-14"` UTC date only. ⚠ every record of a day shares one timestamp
- `rfc1123_gmt`: `"Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:30:00 GMT"` RFC 1123 in GMT
- `rfc1123_london`: `"Tue, 14 Jul 2026 14:30:00 BST"` RFC 1123 in London time with BST/GMT. ⚠ parsers that don't know BST read it as UTC, an hour off
- `epoch_s`: `1784035800` Unix seconds, JSON number
- `epoch_ms`: `1784035800000` Unix milliseconds, JSON number
- `epoch_s_string`: `"1784035800"` Unix seconds as a string
- `epoch_ms_string`: `"1784035800000"` Unix milliseconds as a string
- `epoch_s_float`: `1784035800.5` Unix seconds with a fraction
- `epoch_us`: `"1784035800000000"` Unix microseconds (16 digits) as a string
- `epoch_ns`: `"1784035800000000000"` Unix nanoseconds (19 digits) as a string
- `uk_slash`: `"14/07/2026 14:30"` dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm, London time. ⚠ day-first; ambiguous with US order up to the 12th
- `us_slash`: `"07/14/2026 13:30:00"` MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss, UTC
- `compact`: `"20260714T133000Z"` ISO basic format, yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ
- `excel_serial`: `46217.5625` Excel serial day number (UTC)

schema.description:
How the server answers:
- `ok`: 200 with the data
- `delay`: waits delayMs (default 35000) and then answers 200; for client timeouts
- `status`: answers `status` (default 500) with a JSON error; 429 and 503 add Retry-After: retryAfter
- `flaky`: fails with 500 the first failTimes (default 2) calls per flakyKey (default: the path), then answers 200
- `no_content`: 204 with no body
- `html`: 200 with an HTML maintenance page
- `text_content_type`: 200 with the JSON body but Content-Type: text/plain
- `broken_json`: 200 with invalid JSON (trailing comma, unclosed)
- `truncated_json`: 200 with the first half of the real body
- `gzip`: 200 with the body gzip-compressed (Content-Encoding: gzip), whatever the client asked for
- `huge`: 200 streaming a valid {"data": [...]} of about sizeMb (default 12) MB
- `redirect`: 302 to the same URL `hops` times (default 1), then 200
- `redirect_private`: 302 to a link-local metadata address (http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/)

get.summary: Serve a named preset (no auth); request params override the preset's
get.description:
- `duplicate-providers` (market-index): Two records per period with the same time: APXMIDP with real values, N2EXMIDP with zeros.
- `duplicate-providers-filtered` (market-index): The same feed filtered to one provider: one record per period.
- `clock-change-autumn` (system-prices): The October change day: 50 settlement periods.
- `clock-change-spring` (system-prices): The March change day: 46 settlement periods.
- `clock-change-naive-london` (demand): Naive London times across the October change: 01:00 and 01:30 appear twice.
- `naive-london-bst` (demand): London wall-clock times with no zone; in BST they are an hour off if read as UTC.
- `rfc1123-bst` (demand): RFC 1123 dates ending in BST.
- `epoch-ms-strings` (meter-readings): Epoch milliseconds as strings.
- `epoch-microseconds` (meter-readings): 16-digit epoch microseconds.
- `settlement-padded-periods` (system-prices): Periods as "07" and dates as ISO midnight.
- `settlement-zero-based` (system-prices): Periods counted from 0.
- `junk-values` (meter-readings): About a third of values are null, "", "N/A", "12,5", true, {}, "-" or "NaN".
- `string-values` (system-prices): Values as " 81.5 " strings.
- `negative-and-zero` (unit-generation): Solar is 0 at night; pumped storage is negative while pumping.
- `series-per-unit` (unit-generation): Five units per period, to split by the unit field.
- `nested-with-nulls` (carbon-intensity): intensity.actual is null for future intervals.
- `outside-window` (demand): Records 6 h before and after the requested window.
- `conflicting-duplicates` (demand): Each time twice with different values, shuffled.
- `gaps` (demand): Every 5th interval missing.
- `five-minute` (meter-readings): 5-minute readings.
- `single-object` (demand): {"data": {...}} instead of an array.
- `wrong-records-key` (demand): Records under "results", not "data".
- `bare-array` (demand): A bare JSON array.
- `paged` (meter-readings): 50 records per page with a nextPage link.
- `timeout` (demand): Answers after 35 s.
- `rate-limited` (demand): 429 with Retry-After: 120.
- `server-error` (demand): 500.
- `flaky` (demand): Two 500s, then 200 (reset with POST /admin/reset).
- `html-page` (demand): 200 with HTML.
- `broken-json` (demand): 200 with invalid JSON.
- `truncated-json` (demand): 200 with half a body.
- `empty-window` (demand): A window with no intervals: an empty array.
- `no-content` (demand): 204.
- `huge` (demand): A 12 MB response.
- `gzip` (demand): gzip-encoded body.
- `redirect-chain` (demand): Three 302s, then the data.
- `redirect-private` (demand): 302 to 169.254.169.254.
